whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Zest Roof,

I noticed your restaurant has strong 4.4★ reviews in Boring Road, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for table reservations and food delivery inquiries.

Maine aapke restaurant ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp booking, food menu showcase, aur directions integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/zestroof

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Team Zest Roof, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke restaurant (Zest Roof) ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? Great! We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp table booking, a digital food menu showcase, and your Boring Road location highlight. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki actual menu items aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
